sentences.text: On S.A. I am the petitioner in the present case.
I have settled all my disputes and claims with respondent no.2, who is my wife, and now we are living together for the last more than three years with our daughter who is 16 years of age.
I have transferred Rs.3,77,619/- in the account of my wife.
Today, a draft of Rs.9,72,381/- and cash of Rs. 1,50,000/- has been handed over to respondent no.2, which she can use in any manner she likes.
I also undertake to pay her a sum of Rs.7500/- per month as pocket money and I will bear all the household expenses and other expenses of my wife-Sunita and daughter- Roshita Panwar.
